messages:
Oliver: FYI rolling v4.8.0 -> canary (10% traffic) at 09:12 UTC, noticing a small but persistent p95/p99 uplift on a subset of tenants :thinking_face:
Maya: saw the spike in the dashboard, p95 +180ms, p99 +420ms for the last 3 windows. affected mainly short-seq chat requests (~64 tokens). :eyes:
Priya: linking the trace view: https://redwood.internal/perf/traces?span=runtime.infer&since=09:10 UTC
Sam: any aborts or 429s? or is it pure tail latency?
Oliver: pure tail latency, no increase in errors. error rate steady. retried requests look normal.
metrics-bot: alert: p99 latency (canary cohort) breached 450ms threshold at 09:15 UTC.
deploy-bot: deployment v4.8.0 canary started: 12 hosts, kernel=sched-v2, quant-bins=8
Priya: hypothesis: new scheduler change in sched-v2 + small batch sizes causing queuing jitter for short sequences.
Maya: I can repro on a synthetic short-seq workload locally. When forcing small batch =1 I see p99 jump.
Sam: repro steps? can we share a minimal load generator config?
Maya: snippet:
```
ab --concurrency=32 -n 5000 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" \
  POST http://canary-runtime.internal/v1/generate \
  body: {"input":"hello","max_tokens":32}
```
response times median ~60ms, p99 ~520ms consistently.
Oliver: good. I pulled host-level metrics: CPU idle is fine, GPU utilization slightly lower on canary hosts, KV cache hit rate identical. No memory pressure.
Priya: interesting. stack traces show occasional long syscall in epoll_wait on the worker side around the slow requests. Could be selector scheduling change.
Sam: did we change kernel selector in v4.8.0?
Oliver: yes — kernel selector heuristics updated to prefer fused attention kernel for short sequences if available. That change went into the runtime binary bumped in this rollout.
Priya: flip that heuristic locally and p99 returns to baseline.
Maya: can we patch a canary host to force previous kernel selector? quick config toggle exists: KERNEL_SELECTOR=legacy

Sam: timeline and options: 1) rollback canary to v4.7.3 (fast) 2) patch kernel selector flag across canary hosts (faster) 3) bisect commit to narrow root cause (slower)

Oliver: agree. I'd prefer toggle first to minimize churn. I'll patch 3 hosts and watch.
sre-oncall: FYI if we rollback, we should notify customers on canary that some requests might be routed differently during rollback.
Oliver: patching flag now on 3 hosts (hosts c1,c2,c3).
Maya: after patch on c1-p99 dropped back to ~90ms within 2 windows. c2/c3 confirming. :tada:
metrics-bot: p99 alert resolved at 09:28 UTC (canary cohort).
Priya: good signal. we should still bisect the kernel selector change to find exact code path causing the regression. Can someone open a tiny bisect PR?
Sam: I'll start git bisect across the kernel selection commits. tagging you @Priya for trace artifacts.
Oliver: ops notes for postmortem: root cause appears to be fused-attention kernel under small batch/short sequence causing occasional tail stalls due to internal buffer refill path. Mitigation: revert selector or add short-seq fastpath check.

Maya: immediate follow-up: add a canary-only runtime flag defaulting to legacy for short_seq <= 128 until we have a patch.

Priya: long-term: add microbench harness for fused kernels with short sequences and continuous load to detect regressions earlier.

Sam: bisect progress: narrowing to commit 7f3a2 -> 7f3a6 (kernel perf heuristics). I'll post exact repro PR with docker image.

Oliver: thanks team. I'll keep canary at the patched selector for now and schedule a controlled rollout with the patched kernel selector fix once Sam confirms which commit to revert or adjust.

Maya: customer-facing support: should we proactively message the two customers who hit latency? I can draft DM explaining temporary canary routing change and that production unaffected.

sre-oncall: +1 to notify. Also add a monitoring rule to alert on p95 delta >100ms post-rollout automatically.

Oliver: action items captured: 1) Sam: complete bisect + PR (ETA 3h) 2) Priya: add fused-kernel microbench (ETA 48h) 3) Maya: support outreach message (ETA 1h) 4) Oliver: keep canary patched and coordinate rollout (ongoing)

deploy-bot: canary hosts updated: c1,c2,c3 (KERNEL_SELECTOR=legacy)

Sam: starting bisect now, will post intermediate findings in this thread.
Priya: thanks all — excellent fast loop. :heart:
